players.product: silicon-photonics foundry services (PH18 SiPho platform) + SiGe drivers/TIAs

connects_to.relationship: SiPho foundry for Marvell coherent optical module PICs

contracts.signal: 6-K release: Tower, in partnership with Marvell Technology, has shipped over five million coherent photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to Marvell global customers for AI-driven data center interconnect (DCI) networks. The companies collaborate on next-generation coherent technologies, including integration of non-silicon materials, 3D integration of electronics and advanced optical packaging such as V-Grooves. Marvell SVP and CTO Optical Engineering Radha Nagarajan called Tower 'one of our key ecosystem partners' for scale-across data center architectures.
contracts.units: over five million coherent PICs shipped (cumulative)
